status.title: Copper · Near term
status.sub: Futures fell about 11% in a week (SHFE main contract: 103,510 on Nov 17 to 92,410 CNY/t on Nov 24), while the spot premium stays at a record 1,900 CNY/t — a severe futures–spot divergence. Updated 2026-11-25

status.title: Copper · 2027
status.sub: Institutional 2027 average forecasts span 13,000–15,400 USD/t, centred above the current LME price; refined output is in small surplus while the mine side stays tight — not a trending decline. Monthly review · 2026-11-20

status.title: Refrigerants · Policy
status.sub: China's 2027 HFC quota total matches 2026 (production quota 1.853bn tCO2e); the first cut lands in 2029, so sellers keep pricing power. Updated 2026-10-15 (quota plan)

status.title: Refrigerants · Prices
status.sub: 2026 contract prices rose quarter by quarter — Q3 R32 about 66,600 CNY/t and R134a about 68,400 CNY/t; 2027 is likely flat to slightly higher. Updated 2026-11-20

spot_rows.head: SMM 1# copper spot 104,900 CNY/t (Nov 19)
spot_rows.body: A basis of about +10,000 CNY/t over futures, the widest in a year — the source of the futures-down / spot-tight divergence. (per the research report)

copper.src: Sources: SHFE daily closes via Sina Futures public feed (continuous main contract); LME on the Westmetall 3M basis. Spot premium and basis are point-in-time figures, not daily series; each is dated.

rows.view: Mine supply disappoints; risks skewed down (AI positioning, fading tariff expectations)
Easing from highs but a tight balance holds
Small refined surplus, not a shortage (balance: ~+104 kt in 2026, ~+368 kt in 2027; not a price forecast)
Long-term mine gap: primary supply shortfall of ~25% by 2035; demand +50% by 2040 vs today

forecasts.src: Sources: World Bank Commodity Markets Outlook (Oct 2026), Cochilco Q3 report, ICSG (2026-10-14); bank forecasts as reported by public media, not the original reports. Updated monthly; every revision leaves a dated line (date · old → new · source).

items.name: Downside
items.trig: Triggers: tariff postponed, US stocks flow back, risk-asset deleveraging

items.name: Base case
items.trig: Triggers: inventory mismatch heals slowly, mine side stays tight, wide range

items.name: Upside
items.trig: Triggers: smelter cuts, US tariff lands, macro easing

scenarios.now_body: LME 3M $12,054/t (Nov 24), already in the downside band; SHFE main contract 92,410 CNY/t, spot premium 1,900 CNY/t. Scenario bands are H1-2027 projections, not price targets; reviewed monthly against actuals.
scenarios.src: Source: in-house synthesis of the public institutional forecasts above (research report, 2026-11-20); not trading advice.

rows.head: R32 65,600 CNY/t · R410A 60,500 CNY/t
rows.body: Q4 contract reference prices. (Daily-briefing basis, Longzhong / Mysteel)

rows.head: Q1 2027 contracts flat to slightly higher (~0–3%)
rows.body: A further peak-season rise in Q2–Q3 is likely (Q3 2026 rose 7–10% in one quarter). R32 is up about 3.5x from ~17,000 CNY/t at the start of 2024.

refrigerant.src: Sources: contract prices are tax-inclusive major-maker contract averages from public market compilations (research report, 2026-11-20); dealer spot usually runs 2,000–4,000 CNY/t higher. Verify against Sci99 / Baiinfo or supplier quotes before decisions; price sources are paid databases with no public links.

rows.law: AIM Act + equipment transition rules (new equipment GWP<700)
rows.state: Production/consumption at 60% of baseline; new R410A equipment already switched to R454B / R32
Sep 2026 final ruling proposes 5 more years of duties

nodes.head: Does the US 15% refined-copper tariff land?
nodes.body: The Commerce Department has proposed it; not yet approved. If postponed, the ~1.6 Mt the US stockpiled could flow back and pressure prices.

nodes.head: China's annual HFC quota plan window
nodes.body: The 2027 plan was published on 2026-10-15: total unchanged vs 2026; the only volume change is +150 t of HFC-236fa for semiconductor use.

nodes.head: China and the US tighten in step
nodes.body: China's first quota cut meets the US step-down to 30% of baseline; quota front-running is possible into 2029 and structural high prices persist.

policy.src: Sources: MEE 2027 HFC quota plan (2026-10-15), US EPA AIM Act notices, EU F-gas regulation (compiled in the research report, 2026-11-20). These dates also feed Section 6 anchors and the calendar subscription.
